rules.suspicious: highest risk-score cut-off with val recall >= 0.95
rules.scam: lowest risk-score cut-off with val precision >= 0.97
rules.uncertain_band: narrowest band around model_threshold (half-width <= 0.3) with val selective accuracy >= 0.98; target met: False
